title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode20 Composing the Future

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Sigh... Did this really change anything?
It's all such a pain in the ass.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Come on, don't get too upset.
You're glad everything worked out, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I listened to all of OWN's songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I knew I could feel you in them. They sounded just like you.
What kind of sound do I have?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm so glad you were able to find your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now we can finally sing together.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your true feelings are about to give birth to a new song. Look.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Is this what you mentioned before, Miku?

This song is my true feelings?
But I still haven't found anything yet.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's not true. You've found it, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This SEKAI, and the song within it, are proof of that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Why do we have to sing as well?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Without all of you, she would not have been able to find her true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to thank all three of you for coming here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I-I only came here to give her a piece of my mind.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hearing that from you is so annoying.

I wanted somebody to find me.
Isn't that right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh! Hey, take a look at the shared folder!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Ouch! Don't suddenly yell like that!
Now what's this about the shared folder? Huh?>
<Miku said that once I found my true feelings, they would give birth to a new song.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Does that mean we can finally put this whole mess behind us? What a relief...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yuki, you sure caused us a heap of trouble.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You say that, but you still came running to help in the end♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I already told you I just went to tell her off!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I'm still mad, just so you know.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Still, I'm looking forward to working together again, Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's going to be morning soon. We should call it a night. I want to get some sleep so we can start working on our next song tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're right. Besides, I'm actually super tired.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There's a little something I want to suggest...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just wanted you to know, Dad. Something great happened.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I met a girl a little like myself and wrote a song for her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She never did listen to it, but in the end she was still able to find something important to her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Her true feelings...and her true song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm still not able to save anyone with my music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So one day, I'd like you to listen to it again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I have somewhere to be, so I should get going.
I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... He's just talking in his sleep?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It's been a while since I've heard you say my name.
